title: On the Rigidity of Analytic Mappings in Complex Analysis and Geometry
summary: We establish rigidity results for holomorphic mappings and plurisubharmonic functions in complex geometry. First, under mild conditions, we show that the gradient of a $\operatorname{U}(1)$-invariant strictly plurisubharmonic function in $\mathbb{C}^2$ possesses finite fibers and induces a analytic mapping of topological degree $1$ on the symplectic quotient.
